title: Akane-banashi
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: When Akane Osaki was a child, her father, a rakugo storyteller, was expelled from the Arakawa school during his promotion exam by the master Issho Arakawa. Six years later, Akane, secretly trained by her father's old master Shiguma, sets out to reach rakugo's top rank to vindicate him and prove the art is a worthy profession. Written by Yuki Suenaga with art by Takamasa Moue; Viz publishes it, and NYPL listed it among 2023 Best Books for Teens.
life_message: It holds up mastery of a craft, honoring one's father and perseverance through apprenticeship.
